sources.title: "When Is He Going Back in Your Belly?" How to Help Older Siblings Adjust to the New Baby
sources.quote: Taking steps backwards in development is often a sign of stress. ... when you respond to the need your child is expressing ... let him know his feelings are understood and valid. ... calmly take hold of her hands ... and show her how she can safely engage with her sibling. ... Avoid putting pressure on your child to be in love with the new baby. ... Whenever possible, carve out some special just for you and your older child to be together ... Encourage your older child to help with the new baby, but don't force it.
sources.supports: A step backwards is often a sign of stress, respond to the need behind it, say the feelings are understood and valid, calm firm limits with a showing of a safe way, no pressure to love the baby, special time, and helping with the baby only if the child wants. The page prints one dash inside the limits sentence, shown here as three dots.

sources.title: Preparing Your Child for a New Sibling
sources.publisher: Child Mind Institute, by Juliann Garey, last reviewed or updated 2 January 2026
sources.quote: get in some extra special alone time with each parent ... Have your older child help get things ready for the new baby. ... Babies aren’t easy. ... They can’t do things on their own. ... It is totally normal for children to engage in regressive behaviors when a new baby arrives
sources.supports: Alone time with each parent, letting the older child help, telling the child that babies are not easy and cannot do things on their own, and that regression is normal when a new baby arrives.

sources.title: Preparing for a new sibling
sources.quote: Set aside special one-on-one time for your older child as much as you are able. ... Find ways to include your child in caring for their new sibling ... Tell them what a great big brother or sister they are when you notice them being loving toward your new baby.
sources.supports: One-on-one time, including the older child in the baby's care, and praise when the child is loving toward the baby.

sources.title: Welcoming A New Baby
sources.quote: Encourage your child to talk with you about his feelings.
sources.supports: Encourage the older child to talk about feelings; it is normal to sometimes wish things were as before the baby.

sources.title: How to help your toddler or preschooler adjust to a new sibling
sources.quote: Even 10 minutes of "special time" a day will reassure them that they're important too.
sources.supports: Ten minutes a day of special time reassures the older child. A brand blog, used as general advice.

sources.title: How to Help Your Child Develop Empathy
sources.quote: Read stories about feelings.
sources.supports: Reading stories about feelings is one of the ways Zero To Three suggests to help a child with big feelings. The page is about empathy, not about a new sibling or apologies; used only as support for reading stories about a hard moment.

sources.quote: Taking steps backwards in development is often a sign of stress. ... when you respond to the need your child is expressing ... let him know his feelings are understood and valid. ... calmly take hold of her hands ... and show her how she can safely engage with her sibling. ... 17:30 בגינה אמרו לי להתנצל 🤝
9 דברים שיעזרו לי להגיד סליחה באמת.
תני לי להירגע קודם ותקשיבי לי.
תשאלי איך הוא מרגיש ובואי נעשה משהו בשבילו.
בלי איום ובלי עונש ותתנצלי גם את.
ובערב אפשר להמשיך עם סיפור שבו אני הגיבורה.
תשמרי את הפוסט לפעם הבאה שקשה לה להגיד סליחה 🔖

כולם מסתכלים עליי 🤝
ואני רוצה להיעלם
תעזרי לי להגיד סליחה
כשאני מוכנה.

1 תני לי להירגע קודם
2 תקשיבי לי קודם
כשאני רגועה אני שומעת
ואז גם מבינה אותו.

3 תשאלי איך הוא מרגיש
״יעל, ראית איך הוא הרגיש?״
ככה אני מבינה אותו.

4 נבנה מחדש את המגדל
5 נביא לו משהו קר
עושים משהו בשבילו
ולא רק אומרים מילה.

6 תזכירי לי בעדינות
״רוצה להגיד לו משהו?״
זה מספיק.

7 בלי איום ובלי עונש
8 אל תדחפי כשלא מוכנה
אני אתנצל כשאהיה מוכנה
וזה יהיה אמיתי.

9 תתנצלי גם את
כשאת אומרת סליחה
אני רואה איך עושים.

כשנרגעתי ושמעת אותי
קל לי לתקן
תעזרי לי להגיד סליחה
בפעם הבאה?

תשמרי את הפוסט
לפעם הבאה שקשה לה להגיד סליחה 🔖
